title: What Reaches Expert Review? Representation, Structural Screening, and Candidate-Form Dependence in AI-Assisted Item Development
abstract: arXiv:2608.23766v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Between AI-assisted item generation and expert review sits a computational evaluator whose decisions are usually treated as technical preliminaries. Yet representation, structural reduction, and selection policy determine which items and evidence psychometricians ever receive. Across two linked in-silico studies of 32,000 selected Big Five items, we followed fixed source populations from semantic representation through structural evaluation and candidate-form construction. Broad agreement in semantic geometry concealed consequential local differences: identical wording acquired different construct evidence, different items survived, and intended attributes could disappear even as community correspondence improved. These sensitivities also differed across generated source populations. At the final review boundary, both eligibility policies filled every content cell in every evaluable form, yet they presented different wording. Across em

translated_title: 什么能到达专家评审？AI辅助题目开发中的表征、结构筛选与候选形态依赖性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23766v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：在AI辅助题目生成与专家评审之间，存在一个计算评估器，其决策通常被视为技术性预备步骤。然而，表征、结构简化及选择策略决定了心理测量学家最终能接收到哪些题目和证据。通过对32,000个精选大五人格题目的两项关联的计算机模拟研究，我们追踪了固定来源群体从语义表征到结构评估和候选形态构建的全过程。语义几何中的广泛一致性掩盖了关键性的局部差异：相同的措辞获得了不同的构念证据，不同的题目得以存活，且即使社区对应性改善，预期属性也可能消失。这些敏感性在不同生成的来源群体间也有所不同。在最终评审边界，两种资格政策均填满了每个可评估形态中的每个内容单元格，但呈现了不同的措辞。跨仿真中……
tldr: 本研究揭示了AI辅助题目生成中，从语义表征到结构筛选和候选形态构建的每个环节都会显著影响最终到达专家评审的题目内容和证据，且这种影响在不同来源群体间存在差异。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that in AI-assisted item development, each stage from semantic representation to structural screening and candidate-form construction significantly affects which items and evidence reach expert review, with these effects varying across source populations.
